text:
jess: heads up — acct ACME (enterprise) opened a ticket: after canarying model v5.2 some tool calls are failing with schema validation errors and occasional 401s. customer sees spike in billing for re-tried requests :warning:

jess: sample error from our logs:
```json
{"error":"schema_validation","message":"missing field: tool_params","request_id":"req_01Gx...","model":"v5.2-canary"}
```

sanjay: can you paste the original request body they sent?
jess: here's the sanitized payload (customer redacted):
```json
{
  "input":"Summarize the invoice",
  "tool_call":{
    "name":"invoice_parser",
    "args":null
  },
  "metadata":{ "user_id":"acct-ACME-123" }
}
```

alex: null args is suspicious — v5.2 changed tool selection heuristics; maybe it chose a variant that expects tool_params instead of args.

eng-oncall: reprod steps from my side:
1) curl to /v1/exec with model=v5.2-canary
2) body above -> get 400 schema_validation missing tool_params
3) same body to model=v5.1 returns success 200 and proper tool invocation

support_lead: customer is pretty upset, says retries caused double billing; wants ETA for fix or rollback.

jess: they saw intermittent 401s too — looks like some requests got routed to a dedicated pool with different auth guard? logs show auth check failed for a handful of requests when the model routing used fallback variant.

ops-bot: deploy-bot reported canary rollout completed to 3 regions at 2026-03-17T09:34:02Z :rotating_light: 
deploy-bot: rollback available via: `/deploy rollback v5.2 --canary`

alex: hypothesis: v5.2 introduced a tool schema change (tool_params required) + selector alias mapping caused some requests to map to a variant that enforces strict schema. v5.1 accepts args=null and coalesces.

sanjay: quick mitigation: pin ACME to model=v5.1 on the customer routing layer and pause canary in their region. I'll open a routing override.

eng-oncall: agreed. I'm going to pause canary for EU-west and US-east where ACME traffic is concentrated and roll back variant mapping for the affected tool. Doing it now.

jess: messaging to customer: ✅ we pinned you to v5.1 and paused the v5.2 canary for your org. Please retest and send any failing request ids.

support_lead: we should also offer billing credit for retries — cc @sanjay and @alex for counts.

alex: reproduction notes for eng:
- curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/exec?model=v5.2-canary -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d @payload.json
- payload.json uses "tool_call.args": null to reproduce
- server logs: `tool_runtime: validation_error: missing field tool_params`

eng-oncall: temporary roll back executed at 1769876620 (see deploy-bot). monitoring for errors and auth anomalies.

jess: customer confirms initial retest — tool calls succeed on v5.1, still seeing one earlier 401 trace but overall improved.

support_lead: next steps listed:
- eng: root cause analysis on selector alias and schema mismatch (priority P1)
- eng-oncall: validate auth guard routing for fallback variants
- support: itemize affected request ids and prepare credit calculation
- pm/ship: hold v5.2 canary until compatibility test added to CI

eng-oncall: created issue INF-4219 with logs and repro. tagging alex & sanjay.

jess: thanks all. I'll keep the customer updated and close the ticket once we see stable green for 24h. :white_check_mark:
